environment.java_heap_cap: -Xmx512m; process cap, not measured peak memory
environment.workflow: Linux CLI, detached synthetic edit histories

initial_test_corrections: Initial fixture called Blocks.piece for fractional air; production API rejects it. Corrected fixture to type 0.
Initial air-override assertion used y=-100 below natural terrain. Corrected to Terrain.MIN_Y and asserted base terrain is nonempty.
Prototype now stores both seed and generator version, rather than replaying all old worlds with the current generator.
limits: Diagnostic ceilings only: 200000 source edits,100000 touched cells,1024 regions; no production admission change. These are count caps, not a measured decoded-byte or peak-memory bound. Input must be a detached canonical replay owned by one worker. Region trees share immutable nodes; retained memory and full-size fixture performance are not established. Model IDs are retained but model definitions are not packaged by this experiment.
next: Design and test a bounded region codec and global dependency manifest, then integrate versioned save/load, atomic generation publication, conflict-safe undo and late-join transfer. Preserve old saves and within-cell precedence. No production format, network or history replacement has been made.
parent_hosted_checks: Fresh PR observation matched fb76de63: eight successful platform build entries; two publication entries skipped.
playtest: Playtest: compiled and ran the detached CLI migration against actual production WorldVoxels.History and WorldVoxels replay. Expected exact touched-cell geometry and unchanged untouched terrain; observed equality for all three terrain versions. Edge rejection, cancellation/retry and later-edit regression checks passed. Browser/native playtesting does not apply to this tools-only experiment. All 224 existing native source manifest paths remain unchanged, so the existing implementation workflow media still matches game source.
qualification: Full city/maximum admission,20-run budgets,physical GPU,shaped network and32 rendered clients remain pending. No readiness or stable rollout claim.

cases: Raw ordered replay equals indexed legacy replay and migrated region replay for every touched cell.
Terrain versions 1, 2 and 3; explicit air over nonempty natural terrain; untouched seeded terrain.
Negative 16-cell boundaries and exact world-coordinate limits.
Whole model ID 1024, fractional building materials and LED colours.
Repeated/mixed-depth edit precedence; immutable region maps, lists and frozen trees.
Later edits to a restored world leave retained prototype snapshot unchanged.
Exact budget success; edit, cell and region overflow rejection; invalid edit and invalid diagnostic budget rejection.
Cancellation before replay and during final region snapshot; interruption flag preserved; retry and empty input succeed.
